description: This file contains shell scripts for platform-specific upgrade procedures, including image validation, partition management, and EFI system partition handling for a Linux-based embedded system.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and partition layout of a new system image before upgrading.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a designated partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates EFI boot files in the system partition with files from a new image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the overall upgrade process, including partition management and flashing new images.
